newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel down 10.34 pct to 19.50 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Piltel down 10.34 pct to 19.50 pesos.

text.p: Cellular phone firm Pilipino Telephone Corp (Piltel) shed 2.25 pesos, or 10.34 percent, to 19.50 pesos in mid-session on Friday on talks the company had to drop subscribers with bad accounts, brokers said.
"The market's bearish on Piltel because of the cloning problem. The company had to remove the bad accounts from its subscriber base," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities.
Raul Ruiz, Sun Hung Kai vice-president, on the other hand, said there is talk that Piltel had to remove 10 percent of its subscribers because of unpaid bills.
"Investors are not taking chances with talks of a cut in subscriber base so they decided to sell and shift to other issues," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Citisecurities Inc.

Piltel officials were not immediately available for comment but the company has said earlier it had instituted anti-fraud measures to fight the problem of fraudulent calls by groups using cloning devices.
Piltel's 1996 results are due to be announced in the next few days. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418939 fax 8176267
